cio.headline: Agentic change, on the estate you already have.
cio.banner: Agent proposes · Policy decides · Workflow writes
cio.bannerSmall: The AI never holds business rules and never writes to a system of record

cards.title: Agent proposes
cards.text: Understands the request and recommends. It holds no rules and can't write to any system.

cards.title: Policy decides
cards.text: One versioned rule checks authorisation, overdue balance and availability. It runs before the offer and again before the order.

cards.title: Workflow writes
cards.text: The only part that changes records. It works step by step, with retries and a full audit trail.

messages.title: Nothing ripped out
messages.text: Salesforce and the older systems stay as the records.

messages.title: No lock-in
messages.text: Salesforce and the older systems are reached only through TM Forum Open APIs (TMF-aligned).

messages.title: Controls hold
messages.text: Authorisation, overdue balance, availability and the customer's go-ahead are all checked before any order, never left to the AI.

messages.title: Every step evidenced
messages.text: One timeline from request to live service.

cio.galleryHeading: Proof: the real records in Salesforce
cio.galleryIntro: Lightning record pages from the Salesforce org for the recorded happy-path run, in story order. AgenticTelco demo records only; user details are blurred.
